method.search: Starting from the retained period-110880 assignment, hold all 55 inherited shifts fixed. Score every shift of each of the five factor-two tiles against every rooted period-55440 hole and its four-point fiber. Update all five to their least maximizing exact best responses and repeat until a complete sweep changes no shift or four sweeps complete.
method.stopping_rule: After this declaration is committed, run the frozen producer once and the independently implemented checker once. Retain the polish only if the checker reconstructs the frozen source and both predecessor artifacts, all 12,294,374,400 point outcomes, the exact rooted residual, and least-shift coordinate optimality for all five movable tiles.

next_obligation: Lift the exact local residual through factor three, the best remaining compatible density-per-fiber candidate; only a zero-hole full-pool certificate can enter the frozen affine verifier.
nonclaims: This 60-tile assignment is not an exact cover.
Five-coordinate optimality with 55 inherited shifts fixed is not joint or global optimality.
The result says nothing about assignments that move an inherited shift.
A bounded period-110880 residual is not evidence that no finite cover exists.
The producer and checker are not a Vela Verification or Decision.

preknowledge.disclosure: An exact all-point exploratory run observed the three-sweep convergence, final five shifts, hole count, and improvement before this qualification was frozen.
preknowledge.effect: The iteration receives no Claim credit. Its retained value, if any, is independent exact qualification of the scoped coordinate optimum and smaller residual.
